name: Agnews_MIA_benchmark_RH
description: A benchmark measuring susceptibility of classifiers trained on the AGNews dataset to membership inference attacks (MIA). It evaluates how well attack models can determine whether specific examples were part of a target model's training set, providing a privacy-focused assessment of model leakage. The data and attack setups enable comparison of defenses and attack strategies on a standard news classification corpus.
reputation: Niche privacy/security benchmark used primarily in membership-inference and ML privacy research; limited mainstream adoption.
